content.query:
STEPS:

--1 CHECK DUPLICATE
SELECT  CustomerId, EmailTypeId,PeriodStartTimeStamp, FinancialInstitutionId,SOURCECODE, count(1)
FROM bnkm.CustomerEmail -- WHERE CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = ''
GROUP BY CustomerId, EmailTypeId,PeriodStartTimeStamp, FinancialInstitutionId,SOURCECODE
HAVING count(1) > 1



--2 TAGGED DUPLICATE   with pipeline alternative
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY  CustomerId, EmailTypeId,PeriodStartTimeStamp, FinancialInstitutionId,SOURCECODE ORDER BY PeriodEndTimeStamp DESC, INSERTDTTM DESC ) RN , --define PKs in partition by
*  --Name of backup table to store duplicate records
FROM bnkm.CustomerEmail;



--3 CHECK COUNT MAIN AND BU TABLE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bnkm.CustomerEmail_WITH_DUP_20230531
--
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bnkm.CustomerEmail
--

--4 CLEAN DUP
TRUNCATE TABLE bnkm.CustomerEmail;



--5 INSERT BACK UNIQUE RECORDS ONLY
INSERT INTO bnkm.CustomerEmail --Target table to remove duplicate
SELECT  
CustomerId
,EmailTypeId
,EmailAddress
,PeriodStartTimestamp
,PeriodEndTimestamp
,PreferenceId
,CustomerEmailNote
,DoNotDisturbIndicator
,DateOfRequest
,FinancialInstitutionId
,SourceCode
,TaskRunId
,WorkFlowId
,InsertDttm

FROM bnkm.CustomerEmail_WITH_DUP_20230531 -- Name of backup table to store duplicate records
WHERE RN = 1;


--6 CHECK IF STILL HAVE DUP
SELECT  CustomerId, EmailTypeId,PeriodStartTimeStamp, FinancialInstitutionId,SOURCECODE, count(1)
FROM bnkm.CustomerEmail -- WHERE CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = ''
GROUP BY CustomerId, EmailTypeId,PeriodStartTimeStamp, FinancialInstitutionId,SOURCECODE
HAVING count(1) > 1



--7 COUNT
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bnkm.CustomerEmail_WITH_DUP_20230531
--
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bnkm.CustomerEmail
--
